Box kit allows safe use of electrical appliances outdoors and in DIY environments. Features 5 cable outlets with 2 optional M20 glands. Contains weatherproof, outdoor, single inline IP54 socket with 8m extension lead and smart plug adaptor, enabling control of garden appliances such as seasonal decorative lighting through touch, voice commands or via the BG Home app. Allows user to set timers to switch a device on or off at specific times, use the random function to mimic home lighting activity, or turn on/off multiple devices together. Does not require gateway hub unit or subscriptions.
